title: Crispy Air Fryer Chips
steps: Cut potatoes into 1cm chips and rinse off starch.
Dry thoroughly and toss with oil paprika and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 20–24 minutes shaking twice until golden and tender.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Skin-On Potato Wedges
steps: Scrub potatoes and cut into even wedges.
Dry and toss with oil and seasonings.
Air fry at 195°C for 22–25 minutes turning halfway until crisp and cooked through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Baby Roast Potatoes
steps: Halve larger baby potatoes and pat dry.
Toss with oil rosemary and salt.
Air fry at 195°C for 18–22 minutes shaking halfway until soft inside.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Hasselback Potatoes
steps: Cut thin slices across each potato without cutting all the way through.
Brush with oil and sprinkle thyme and salt.
Air fry at 180°C for 30–35 minutes until centre is tender checking with a knife.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Cut sweet potatoes into thin even fries and dry well.
Toss with cornflour oil and paprika.
Air fry at 190°C for 14–18 minutes shaking halfway and cooking in batches.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Garlic Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes into quarters and toss with oil.
Air fry at 195°C for 18 minutes shaking once.
Add crushed garlic and parmesan and cook 3–4 minutes more then sprinkle parsley.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Air Fryer Jacket Potatoes
steps: Prick potato skins several times and rub with oil and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 40–45 minutes turning halfway.
Check the centre is fully soft and add time if needed.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Cajun Potato Cubes
steps: Cut potatoes into 2cm cubes and dry well.
Toss with oil and Cajun seasoning.
Air fry at 195°C for 17–20 minutes shaking halfway.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Chicken Breast with Herbs
steps: Pat chicken dry and coat with oil herbs and garlic.
Place in a single layer and air fry at 180°C for about 18–20 minutes turning once.
Check thickest centre reaches at least 75°C with a food thermometer and rest 5 minutes.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Paprika Chicken Thighs
steps: Toss chicken with oil paprika and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 20–24 minutes turning halfway.
Check thickest centre reaches at least 75°C before serving.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken
steps: Mix mustard honey and oil and coat chicken.
Air fry at 180°C for 17–20 minutes turning once.
Verify centre reaches at least 75°C and rest before slicing.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Coat drumsticks with oil and seasonings.
Air fry at 190°C for 24–28 minutes turning halfway.
Use thermometer at thickest part avoiding bone to confirm at least 75°C.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Chicken Fajita Strips
steps: Slice pepper and onion and mix with chicken strips oil and seasoning.
Spread in basket without crowding and air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes stirring halfway.
Confirm chicken reaches at least 75°C before serving in tortillas.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Crispy Chicken Goujons
steps: Set up flour beaten egg and breadcrumbs mixed with paprika.
Coat chicken strips in flour egg then breadcrumbs and spray lightly with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes turning once until chicken reaches at least 75°C.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Wings
steps: Pat wings dry and toss with oil salt lemon zest and crushed garlic.
Air fry at 195°C for 22–25 minutes turning halfway.
Check thickest meat reaches at least 75°C then squeeze lemon juice over.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: BBQ Chicken Bites
steps: Coat chicken pieces with oil and half the sauce.
Air fry at 190°C for 12–16 minutes shaking halfway.
Check chicken reaches at least 75°C then toss with remaining sauce and serve.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Salmon Fillets
steps: Brush salmon with oil and sprinkle dill and lemon zest.
Air fry skin-side down at 180°C for 9–11 minutes.
Check fish is opaque flakes easily and is cooked through (about 63°C internally).
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Lemon Cod
steps: Pat cod dry and brush with oil paprika and lemon zest.
Place on lightly oiled liner and air fry at 180°C for 10–12 minutes.
Check fish is opaque and flakes easily and reaches about 63°C internally.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Garlic Prawns
steps: Toss raw prawns with oil and finely chopped garlic.
Air fry at 190°C for 6–8 minutes shaking halfway.
Cook until prawns are pink opaque and piping hot then add parsley.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Breaded Fish Goujons
steps: Dry fish and coat in flour then beaten egg then paprika breadcrumbs.
Spray lightly with oil and arrange without overlap.
Air fry at 190°C for 10–12 minutes turning once until fish is cooked through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Honey Soy Salmon
steps: Mix soy honey and sesame oil and brush over salmon.
Place fillets skin-side down on a suitable liner.
Air fry at 180°C for 10–12 minutes until cooked through checking centre and avoiding burnt glaze.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Crispy Broccoli
steps: Cut broccoli into similar florets and dry thoroughly.
Toss with oil garlic and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 8–11 minutes shaking once until edges brown and stalks tender.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Honey Carrots
steps: Peel and cut carrots into even batons.
Toss with oil and thyme and air fry at 190°C for 12 minutes.
Add honey toss and cook 3–5 minutes until tender.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Roasted Cauliflower
steps: Dry cauliflower florets and toss with oil curry powder and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes shaking halfway.
Cook until edges golden and stalks tender.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Crispy Brussels Sprouts
steps: Trim and halve sprouts and toss with oil and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes shaking halfway.
Toss with balsamic vinegar after cooking.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Courgette Coins
steps: Cut courgettes into 1cm rounds and pat dry.
Toss with oil and oregano and arrange in a layer.
Air fry at 190°C for 9 minutes then sprinkle parmesan and cook 2–3 minutes more.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers and remove seeds.
Mix cooked rice beans salsa and half the cheese then fill peppers.
Air fry at 180°C for 13 minutes top with remaining cheese and cook 3 minutes until peppers soften.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Garlic Mushrooms
steps: Halve large mushrooms and pat dry.
Toss with oil and crushed garlic.
Air fry at 190°C for 9–11 minutes shaking once and garnish with parsley.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Roasted Red Onions
steps: Peel onions and cut into thick wedges.
Toss with oil thyme and vinegar.
Air fry at 185°C for 13–16 minutes turning once until soft and browned.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Halloumi Fries
steps: Cut halloumi into thick sticks and pat dry.
Dust lightly with flour and paprika then brush with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 8–10 minutes turning halfway until golden.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Crispy Tofu Cubes
steps: Press tofu dry and cut into cubes.
Toss with soy sauce sesame oil and cornflour.
Air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes shaking twice until crisp.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Chickpea Crunch
steps: Drain rinse and dry chickpeas very thoroughly.
Toss with oil paprika and cumin.
Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes shaking frequently until crisp and let cool.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Falafel Patties
steps: Drain chickpeas thoroughly and mash with finely chopped onion garlic cumin flour and parsley.
Form small firm patties and brush lightly with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes turning once until browned and heated through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Aubergine Slices
steps: Slice aubergine into 1cm rounds and pat dry.
Brush with oil and sprinkle paprika and garlic.
Air fry at 190°C for 13–16 minutes turning once until soft and golden.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Cheesy Quesadilla
steps: Place cheese chopped spring onion and drained sweetcorn on one tortilla and top with second.
Press edges and place flat in basket secured with a suitable rack if needed.
Air fry at 180°C for 6–8 minutes flipping carefully halfway until cheese melts.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Ham and Cheese Toastie
steps: Butter outside of bread and fill with ham and cheese.
Secure sandwich with a suitable rack or toothpicks so bread cannot blow into heating element.
Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes turning once until crisp and cheese melted.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Mini Pitta Pizzas
steps: Spread pitta with passata and top with cheese sliced tomato and oregano.
Place flat in basket without crowding.
Air fry at 180°C for 6–8 minutes until cheese melts and bases crisp.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Air Fryer Nachos
steps: Put chips in a small air-fryer-safe dish and scatter with cheese and drained beans.
Air fry at 170°C for 5–7 minutes until cheese melts.
Top with salsa and sliced spring onion after cooking.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Crispy Gnocchi
steps: Toss uncooked shelf-stable gnocchi with oil and garlic powder.
Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes shaking twice until golden and hot throughout.
Sprinkle parmesan and serve with warmed tomato sauce.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Breakfast Sausages
steps: Arrange sausages in a single layer with room for airflow.
Air fry at 180°C for 12–14 minutes turning halfway.
Check thickest centre reaches at least 75°C and juices run clear.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Bacon Rashers
steps: Lay bacon in a single layer without overlap and avoid loose greaseproof paper.
Air fry at 180°C for 7–9 minutes turning halfway.
Cook until fully done and crisp to preference.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Breakfast Hash Browns
steps: Grate potatoes and onion then squeeze out as much moisture as possible.
Mix with egg and flour and shape into six small patties brushing with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 14–17 minutes turning halfway until golden and cooked through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Cinnamon French Toast Sticks
steps: Whisk eggs milk cinnamon and sugar.
Cut bread into thick sticks and dip briefly in mixture.
Place on a lightly oiled tray and air fry at 180°C for 8–10 minutes turning halfway until egg coating is fully set.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Baked Breakfast Tomatoes
steps: Halve tomatoes and place cut-side up in a small oven-safe dish.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle oregano and salt.
Air fry at 180°C for 8–10 minutes until softened.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Air Fryer Apple Chips
steps: Core apples and slice very thinly and evenly.
Pat dry and sprinkle cinnamon.
Air fry at 150°C for 12–15 minutes turning frequently and checking to prevent burning then cool to crisp.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Cinnamon Banana Bites
steps: Slice bananas into thick rounds and toss gently with melted butter and cinnamon.
Place on a small suitable liner or tray.
Air fry at 180°C for 6–8 minutes until lightly caramelised.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Air Fryer Scones
steps: Rub butter into flour then stir in sugar and enough milk for soft dough.
Pat to 2cm thick and cut six rounds.
Air fry at 170°C for 12–14 minutes until risen golden and cooked through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Baked Pear Halves
steps: Halve and core pears and place cut-side up in a small air-fryer-safe dish.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle cinnamon.
Air fry at 170°C for 12–14 minutes until tender then scatter walnuts.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Chocolate Croissant Bites
steps: Cut pastry into 12 triangles and put a small piece of chocolate at wide end of each.
Roll up and brush with beaten egg.
Air fry in batches at 175°C for 8–10 minutes until puffed golden and pastry cooked through.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.

title: Air Fryer Garlic Bread
steps: Slice baguette lengthways and mix butter with crushed garlic and parsley.
Spread garlic butter on cut sides and place bread in basket.
Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes until golden and crisp.
notes: Air fryer times are approximate and vary by model, basket load and food thickness. Preheat if your appliance requires it. Follow manufacturer instructions. Check food is safely cooked; use a food thermometer for meat and poultry.
